system: First Aid Knowledge Base - Static Medical Facts & Triage Metadata

severity_levels.red: Life-threatening — Call 123 immediately (خطر يهدد الحياة - اتصل بالإسعاف 123 فوراً)
severity_levels.orange: Urgent — Visit hospital ER or campus clinic now (حالة عاجلة - توجه للمستشفى أو عيادة الجامعة)
severity_levels.green: Minor — Self-care at home and symptom monitoring (حالة طفيفة - إسعاف منزلي ومراقبة)
severity_levels.unknown: Indeterminate — More clinical assessment needed (غير محدد - يتطلب تقييماً إضافياً)

special_rules: Any burn in infants is automatically classified as RED
Respiratory distress in infants is critical (chest indrawing, grunting)
Use back slaps and chest thrusts for choking (Heimlich abdominal thrusts strictly prohibited)
Burns covering > 5% of body surface area require hospital admission
Lower physiological threshold for dehydration and blood loss
Standard adult first aid and CPR guidelines (30:2 ratio, 5-6 cm compression depth)
High osteoporosis risk: any fall carries high risk of hip or cervical fracture
Atypical symptoms: myocardial infarction may present as confusion or fainting without chest pain
